label: Hugging Face
terms_note: Automation allowed (huggingface_hub is the recommended path); Hub API rate limits per 5-min window: anonymous 500 / free 1,000 / PRO 2,500 / Team 3,000 / Enterprise 6,000; resolvers 3,000-50,000; webhooks 1,000 triggers per 24 h; gated repos need a browser-side terms acceptance per user; Gradio/Docker Spaces need a paid plan (static Spaces free; free accounts get 2 ZeroGPU Spaces).

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Hub REST API with OpenAPI spec, `huggingface_hub` SDK + `hf` CLI, Inference Providers,

endpoints.call: push files (resumable, Xet-chunked; folders auto-split into commits)

reference.limits: 5-minute fixed windows (headers `RateLimit`, `RateLimit-Policy`): API bucket anonymous 500 · free 1,000 · PRO 2,500 · Team 3,000 · Enterprise 6,000 · Enterprise Plus 10,000 (100,000 with higher limits); resolvers 3,000 / 5,000 / 12,000 / 20,000 / 50,000 / 100,000; pages 100-1,000. Undocumented per-action caps on repo creation and commits. Webhooks 1,000 triggers per 24 h each. `huggingface_hub` ≥ 1.2 retries 429 using the header. Automation is the documented path. Gradio / Docker Spaces "require a paid plan to create" (PRO personal, Team / Enterprise org); static Spaces free; free accounts ma
mcp_sdk: `pip install huggingface_hub` (`hf auth login`, `hf upload`, `hf models ls --warm`), `@huggingface/hub`,

fields.name: token
fields.help: Hugging Face user access token (https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens); a write (or fine-grained repo write) token for create/update.

adapter.terms: Subject to the Hugging Face Hub rate limits (https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/rate-limits) and each repo's license.

me.note: GET /api/whoami-v2: the token's user, organisations and token role/scopes.

list_items.note: GET /api/{models|datasets|spaces}?search&limit: Hub repositories (collection picks the repo type, default models). Only the first page is returned: the Hub paginates with a Link response header, which the runtime does not follow, so narrow with query.

get_item.note: GET /api/{models|datasets|spaces}/{namespace}/{repo}: repo info (item_id is the full repo id such as google/gemma-2b; files in raw.siblings, card metadata in raw.cardData).

create_item.note: POST /api/repos/create {type, name, organization, private, sdk, license}: creates an empty repo. title is the repo name; collection models|datasets|spaces sets the type (default model); fields may carry organization, private (boolean), sdk (gradio|docker|static, required for spaces) and license. Files are pushed with the commit API (not mapped).

update_item.note: PUT /api/{models|datasets|spaces}/{namespace}/{repo}/settings: repo settings from fields (private, visibility private|public|protected, gated false|auto|manual, discussionsDisabled, gatedNotificationsEmail). title/content are not repo settings and are not sent.

not_offered.generate_image: Hub inference (router.huggingface.co / hf-inference text-to-image) answers with image bytes, which a JSON tool result cannot carry; no URL/job variant is documented.
not_offered.generate_video: Hub inference text-to-video answers with video bytes; no URL/job variant is documented.
not_offered.get_job: No generation job resource on the Hub API (Jobs run compute, not generations).
not_offered.delete_item: DELETE /api/repos/delete takes the repo as separate `name` and `organization` body fields (huggingface_hub HfApi.delete_repo), while item_id is the combined namespace/repo id; the runtime cannot split one argument into two fields.

evidence: probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://huggingface.co/.well-known/openapi.json: 3/5 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
live read without credentials: get_item, list_items returned data that validates against the vocabulary
auth_audit.notes: list_items: spec says "path not in spec: GET /api/models"; waived: the Hub OpenAPI (huggingface.co/.well-known/openapi.json) omits the listing routes; GET /api/models answered 200 live and validated get_item: spec says "path not in spec: GET /api/models/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2"; waived: omitted from the Hub OpenAPI; GET /api/models/{repo_id} answered 200 live and validated
